mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing market contraction, reducing consumer confidence and aggregate demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of interaction periods, or interaction Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during industrial downturns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of INDPRO decline periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening that compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of CPIAUCSL rise periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.0% signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing borrowing costs and reducing economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of FEDFUNDS > 5.0% periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase and employment decline (PAYEMS) signal severe labor market stress, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of interaction periods, or interaction Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 1400 thousand units signals housing market recovery, boosting consumer confidence and spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during housing booms.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of HOUST > 1400 periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.
